title: Super Cup ATTP – Winter 2024: first stage
excerpt: Results of the first stage of the ATTP SUPER CUP – Winter 2024
body_html:
Today, 24 February, the TOP CUP Academy sports complex in Chișinău hosted the first stage of the national table tennis tournament under the auspices of ATTP in the SUPER CUP – WINTER 2024 series, in ranking categories (seniors) A (38.1-45.0) to E (<20), with 75 table tennis amateurs taking part on the first day alone.

Nobody expected that in the first stage, in almost every match, the chief referee and most of those present with us, the organisers, would say at least once: “Yes, that was one of the most memorable, if not the most expressive, matches of the tournament!” What matters is that, after all the twists of the group battles, the first-stage matches were each better than the last.

It matters because this type of competition attracts more and more attention thanks to its quality. It means that every table tennis amateur, even one who “doesn’t meet the conventional standards of mastery”, will not give up the sport, knowing that success can come from results within a given ranking group, not only from holding titles and sporting qualifications.

In the first stage, the winners and prize-winners are:

Group A

1st place – Daniel BELIBOV (team SETKA-Pro)

2nd place – Serghei SIVOVOL (team SETKA-Pro)

3rd place – Nicolai UZUN (team SETKA-Pro)

3rd place – Andrei CALMÎȘ (team SETKA-Pro)
